title.zh-CN: 膝关节痛与尚未来月经 · 16岁女孩
title.en: Knee pain and no menarche · girl aged 16

summary.zh-CN: 青春期关节与月经问题合并异常肝脏和免疫证据，需要跨系统评估。
summary.en: Adolescent joint and menstrual concerns coexist with hepatic and immune abnormalities requiring cross-system assessment.

prompt.zh-CN: 关节痛与月经问题之外，应重点整合什么？
prompt.en: What should be integrated beyond joint and menstrual complaints?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 免疫相关肝炎证据及慢性病对性腺轴的可能影响
text.en: Immune-mediated hepatitis evidence and possible chronic-illness effects on the gonadal axis

feedback.zh-CN: 显著肝酶、IgG及自身抗体异常不能被局部症状掩盖。
feedback.en: Marked liver enzymes, IgG and autoantibody findings require integration.

text.zh-CN: 单纯膝关节病可解释全部检验
text.en: An isolated knee disorder explains all tests

feedback.zh-CN: 不能解释肝脏和免疫异常。
feedback.en: It does not explain liver and immune abnormalities.

text.zh-CN: 一次低LH就证明永久卵巢衰竭
text.en: One low LH proves permanent ovarian failure

feedback.zh-CN: 需区分轴水平、慢性病影响和后续动态。
feedback.en: Axis level, illness effects and longitudinal data matter.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 免疫、排除检查和活检共同支持AIH，但标本有限
text.en: Immune tests, exclusions and histology jointly support AIH, with limited tissue sampling

feedback.zh-CN: 不能将单项ANA或少量组织视为全部诊断标准。
feedback.en: Neither ANA alone nor limited tissue completes all diagnostic assessment.

text.zh-CN: ANA阳性自动等于狼疮性肝炎
text.en: Positive ANA automatically means lupus hepatitis

feedback.zh-CN: 需符合完整系统性疾病证据。

text.zh-CN: 已经证明闭经只由AIH导致
text.en: AIH is proven to be the sole cause of amenorrhoea

feedback.en: A complete amenorrhoea differential is unavailable.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何安排治疗和青春期随访？
prompt.en: How should treatment and puberty follow-up be coordinated?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 肝病及内分泌团队复核诊断、免疫治疗安全及月经轴，保护青春期隐私
text.en: Hepatology/endocrinology should review diagnosis, immunotherapy safety and reproductive axis while protecting adolescent privacy

feedback.zh-CN: 不照搬历史激素冲击剂量，并持续观察功能。
feedback.en: Do not copy historical steroid pulses; follow function longitudinally.

text.zh-CN: 撤退性出血即证明自然排卵恢复
text.en: Withdrawal bleeding proves spontaneous ovulation

feedback.zh-CN: 药物撤退出血不同于自然规律周期。

text.zh-CN: 关节痛消失即可停所有肝病随访

feedback.zh-CN: 肝炎活动与症状可不一致。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：整合IgG、肝酶、排除检查和活检。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：AIH完整评分、其他闭经病因、长期肝病及自然月经转归。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Integrate IgG, liver enzymes, exclusions and histology. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Complete AIH scoring, other amenorrhoea causes, long-term hepatic and spontaneous menstrual outcomes. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告AIH并原发性闭经，肝病改善与生殖轴恢复应分别衡量。
conclusion.en: Reported AIH with primary amenorrhoea requires separate assessment of liver improvement and reproductive recovery.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 区分症状好转、生化缓解和规律排卵。
teachingPoints.en: Distinguish symptomatic improvement, biochemical remission and regular ovulation.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: AIH完整评分、其他闭经病因、长期肝病及自然月经转归。
unknowns.en: Complete AIH scoring, other amenorrhoea causes, long-term hepatic and spontaneous menstrual outcomes.

references: 张俊, 张爱青, 甘卫华. 儿童自身免疫性肝炎并原发性闭经1例. 中华实用儿科临床杂志. 2013;28(19):1517-1518. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.2095-428X.2013.19.022.
EASL. Clinical Practice Guidelines on management of autoimmune hepatitis. 2025. https://easlcampus.eu/sites/default/files/2025-05/EASL_CPGs_on_the_management_of_AIH.pdf

notice.en: A teaching-script measure, not a validated competency score.

testUtterances.text: 膝盖痛了多久，会换地方吗？

到现在有没有来过月经？

青春期变化大约持续几年了？
How long have pubertal changes been progressing?
以前用过避孕药或其他激素吗？

除了关节症状还有什么不舒服？
What symptoms accompany the joint problems?
